findings.title: Migration crashes when the embed_category setting row is absent
findings.body: The SELECT joining categories and site_settings returns no rows on a default install, because embed_category was never set. `[0]['id']` is then called on nil and raises NoMethodError, which aborts the migration. The same applies to the `uncategorized_category_id` lookup on line 15, since that setting may not be stored in site_settings. The result must be guarded, for example with `.first` and a nil check.

findings.title: Unescaped SQL interpolation and unnormalized hosts in migration
findings.body: Host strings from the old setting are interpolated directly into the INSERT. A quote character breaks the SQL, which is an injection risk. Lines are also not stripped of whitespace, `\r` or the http:// prefix, and are not lowercased. Because the model's before_validation hook is bypassed, such rows can be stored invalid and will never match in `host_allowed?`.

findings.title: before_validation crashes on a nil host and mutates in place
findings.body: `self.host.sub!` raises NoMethodError when host is nil. Creating a host without a host param, or `EmbeddableHost.new`, therefore raises instead of failing validation. Also, `sub!` mutates the string in place, which can alter strings shared with the params.

findings.title: Case-sensitive comparison against lowercased column
findings.body: The query compares `lower(host)` to `host` taken from the URI. URI#host preserves case, so a referer like http://EvilTrout.com will not match. Downcase the value before comparing.

findings.title: Nil record not handled in update/destroy
findings.body: `where(...).first` returns nil for an unknown id, so `save_host` or `host.destroy` raises NoMethodError and the client gets a 500 instead of a 404. Use `find`, or check for nil first.

findings.title: Wrong property used when saving
findings.body: `props.category_id` is set from the component's `categoryId`. The saved host then gets `Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))`. If the user selects no category, categoryId is null and the server falls back to the uncategorized category, but the UI sets category to undefined until a reload. Minor, but the displayed state is inconsistent with the server.

findings.title: Category fabricators moved or overwritten
findings.body: category_fabricator.rb now contains the embeddable_host fabricator, and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contains the category fabricators. The content is swapped between the two files. It loads only because Fabrication loads every file, but the names are misleading and it was most likely unintended.
